capabilities: Import palettes from coolors and colorhunt URLs
Copy color codes by selecting them
Generate random palettes from color theory combinations
Create palettes with an advanced palette editor command
disambiguation: Not a theme or CSS editor; it only renders color palettes in notes via codeblocks and links.
extras: Full documentation is hosted externally, linked from the README. The README warns that setting width may cause palettes to display incorrectly.
motivation: Enhancing the appearance of notes with colors; the README frames the plugin as creating beautiful and functional palettes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create, display or reuse color palettes inside notes.
summary: Renders color palettes in notes from codeblocks or palette-site URLs, with a palette editor, random generation and color-code copying.
